scope: Review of existing SDK tests, diagnostic semantics and measurement harness; installed-wheel baseline probes and bounded plan validation, no runtime implementation

focusedTests.testInputs: Checkout test modules and fixtures explicitly added to sys.path; runtime imported from isolated installed a11 wheel
focusedTests.limits: This verifies the existing suite against installed runtime, not checkout-independent distribution of a future testing kit

negativeControls.limits: Scratch controls with current installed SDK and frozen checkout fixture; not acceptance of the unimplemented kit or arbitrary native semantics

differential.limits: Default reference profiles and frozen IPC/SSH examples only; owner-injected profiles need their own oracle

exclusions: No conformance package, public API or diagnostic format implemented
No benchmark, optimization or new transport acceptance
No fresh whole-suite run in this planning pass; prior same-source 85/119/82 review and released package evidence remain separate
No sibling edits, operational hosts, producer collection, managed selection or deployment
